title: GAP-14: [DOCS] Figure gates: Mermaid lint not in CI; five hand-authored SVGs and orphan PNGs ungated (REQ-DOC-001)
body:
[A10] Found by the compliance-matrix audit of `docs/00_MILAN_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW.md` at main 6a878f6 (owner request, 2026-09-18). The matrix Cov column grades the ORIGINAL architecture document; this ticket records what the tree carries today. Baseline at that head: `./scripts/run_suites.sh` exit 0 (30 of 30 suites, 14790 checks), `./scripts/lint_hdl.sh` exit 0.

## Finding

GAP-14 (Info), F00.2 verdict of this audit: **PARTIAL**.

- Resolution claimed in F00.2: All figures Mermaid/WaveDrom/draw.io + lint
- "Addressed in" check: {'ok': True, 'note': 'docs/README.md:81-105 (section 3, one source one home, three formats) and Makefile:9-60 (diagrams, wavedrom, wavedrom-check, lint, links, matrix, modmatrix, stale) exist and say what the resolution claims. docs/diagrams/README.md:32-50 adds a fourth class the resolution does not name: five hand-authored SVGs with no source file.'}
- "Verified by" claimed: lint
- In `hdl/` today: Not an RTL finding. Artifacts: 41 Mermaid fences + 18 WaveDrom blocks across docs/, 18 committed WaveDrom SVGs (docs/diagrams/wavedrom/), 3 draw.io sources + exports (docs/diagrams/src/, docs/diagrams/01-*.svg, 03-*.svg). No ASCII-art residue found in docs/ (box-drawing and +---+ patterns: zero hits).
- In `tb/` today: lint gates run on 2026-09-18 in this clone: scripts/lint-diagrams.sh -> 'lint: 41 mermaid + 18 wavedrom blocks checked, OK' (rc 0); scripts/check-links.py -> '799 checked, OK'; make stale rc 0 (render-wavedrom --check not run: the wavedrom package is absent on this box and the script would bootstrap a venv). CI (.github/workflows/hdl.yml docs-gates) runs links, matrix, render-wavedrom --check and make stale, but NOT scripts/lint-diagrams.sh and not make check, although 09_verification.md:111 calls make check 'the CI gate'. The five hand-authored SVGs (20-24) have no gate, and their five committed PNG exports (git ls-files docs/diagrams | grep -c png = 5) are referenced by no document and covered by no regeneration or staleness rule.

## What remains

The ASCII-diagram finding itself is resolved. What remains is the gate: run scripts/lint-diagrams.sh (or make check) in the docs-gates CI job; bring the hand-authored SVG class into docs/README.md section 3 with a gate or convert the five figures; drop or gate the five orphan PNGs. Same work item as REQ-DOC-001 in slice-F.json.

## REQ-DOC-001 (project charter, design) - audit verdict PARTIAL

Every figure an editable artifact (Mermaid/WaveDrom/draw.io) with committed exports, regeneration and staleness gates

- In `hdl/` today: Exists: docs/README.md:81-105 (figure rules), Makefile:9-10 (check), :18-24 (wavedrom, wavedrom-check), :26-29 (drawio export), :31-32 (lint), :46-60 (stale); scripts/lint-diagrams.sh, scripts/render-wavedrom.py; 3 .drawio sources with SVG exports (docs/diagrams/src/), 18 WaveDrom SVGs (docs/diagrams/wavedrom/), 41 Mermaid fences. Run 2026-09-18: scripts/lint-diagrams.sh -> 'lint: 41 mermaid + 18 wavedrom blocks checked, OK' rc 0; make stale rc 0; no ASCII-art residue found in docs/. CI: .github/workflows/hdl.yml docs-gates runs links, matrix, render-wavedrom --check and make stale.
- In `tb/` today: Holes: (1) CI never runs make lint (the mmdc Mermaid render) nor make check as a whole - hdl.yml docs-gates lists four commands and lint-diagrams.sh is not one, while 09_verification.md:111 says 'make check is the CI gate'; (2) five figures are a fourth, unlisted format - hand-authored SVG with no source and no gate (docs/diagrams/README.md:32-50: 20-rtl-dataflow ... 24-adp-acmp-states), outside the Mermaid/WaveDrom/draw.io set of docs/README.md section 3; (3) their five committed PNG exports (git ls-files docs/diagrams | grep png -> 5) are referenced by no document and have no regeneration target and no staleness gate (Makefile stale covers .drawio only).
- Missing: Mermaid lint in CI; the hand-authored SVG class written into docs/README.md section 3 with a gate (XML well-formedness at least) or converted; the five orphan PNGs either dropped or given a regeneration + staleness rule.
- Searched with: mermaid|wavedrom|drawio|stale (Makefile, scripts/, .github/); \.png (all *.md, Makefile, scripts); box-drawing / +----+ ASCII art (docs/); 2[0-4]-*.svg references (confidence: medium)

## Acceptance

1. The docs-gates CI job runs scripts/lint-diagrams.sh (or make check)
2. docs/README.md section 3 names hand-authored SVG as a figure class with its rule, or the five figures move to a listed format
3. docs/diagrams/2[0-4]-*.png are removed or covered by a regeneration target and make stale
4. 09 section 7 matches what CI actually runs

Executor and reviewers: assigned when the lane opens.
